title: Noietch/EVA-CLIENT
abstract:
EVA-Client: A Unified Framework for Deployment, Evaluation, and Data Collection on Real Robots

EVA-Client: A Unified Framework for Deployment, Evaluation, and Data Collection on Real Robots One policy, any robot — the smooth all-in-one real-robot stack. Debug, record, evaluate, visualize, all in the browser. EVA-Client driving an AgileX bimanual arm end-to-end from the browser — teleop → record → π₀ checkpoint → smooth async deploy. Real hardware, not a rendering. Jump to:   What's NEW · What you get · Robot zoo · Protocols · Architecture · Documentation · Roadmap · Cite --- ## 🔥 What's NEW! * **[2026-08-28] EVA-Client 0.2.0** EVA-Client now supports WebXR-based VR controller teleoperation, ARX X5 hardware, dual-YAM leader-follower data collection, export to LeRobot v3.0, MCAP, and HDF5, and multiple coding-agent skills for adding robots, calibrating cameras, and debugging robot SDKs. * **[2026-08-28] EVA-MHS Preview.** Inspired by Anthropic's [Model Hardware Standard (MHS) research preview](https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-hardware-standard-research-preview), EVA-MHS explores an MHS-style agent-to-hardware interface for robotics. Its MCP service allows coding agents to inspect runtime state, call policy models, and directly control robots. EVA-MHS is available on the `dev/mcp_preview` branch and will be formally released in a future update. * **[2026-07-22] New RL Workspace.** EVA-Client now supports human-in-the-loop (HIL) intervention during policy rollouts and real-time value-curve visualization. See the [RL workspace and HIL intervention demo](./docs/console.md#rl-workspace-and-hil-intervention). * **[2026-07-18] Headless CLI + ZMQ control channel.** Drive the full deploy / eval / RL / collect loop from a single `.py` config without the browser — every console button (incl. HIL takeover) mirrored on a ZMQ socket. See [`docs/console.md`](./docs/console.md) and [`docs/control-channel.md`](./docs/control-channel.md). * **[2026-07-03] EVA-Client is open-sourced!** * **[2026-07-03] Paper, docs, and project page are live!** Read the [Technical Report]
abstract_zh: EVA-Client：面向真实机器人的部署、评估与数据收集统一框架。一个策略，适配任意机器人——流畅的一体化真实机器人技术栈。在浏览器中完成调试、记录、评估与可视化。EVA-Client 从浏览器端到端驱动 AgileX 双臂机械臂——遥操作 → 记录 → π₀ 检查点 → 流畅异步部署。真实硬件，非渲染。快速跳转：最新动态 · 你将获得 · 机器人库 · 协议 · 架构 · 文档 · 路线图 · 引用 --- ## 🔥 最新动态！ * **[2026-08-28] EVA-Client 0.2.0** EVA-Client 现已支持基于 WebXR 的 VR 控制器遥操作、ARX X5 硬件、双 YAM 主从数据收集、导出至 LeRobot v3.0、MCAP 和 HDF5，以及多个编码智能体技能，用于添加机器人、标定相机和调试机器人 SDK。 * **[2026-08-28] EVA-MHS 预览版。** 受 Anthropic 的 [模型硬件标准（MHS）研究预览](https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-hardware-standard-research-preview) 启发，EVA-MHS 探索了一种面向机器人学的 MHS 风格智能体到硬件接口。其 MCP 服务允许编码智能体检查运行时状态、调用策略模型并直接控制机器人。EVA-MHS 已在 `dev/mcp_preview` 分支上提供，并将在未来更新中正式发布。 * **[2026-07-22] 全新 RL 工作区。** EVA-Client 现已支持策略推演期间的人类在环（HIL）干预和实时价值曲线可视化。参见 [RL 工作区与 HIL 干预演示](./docs/console.md#rl-workspace-and-hil-intervention)。 * **[2026-07-18] 无头 CLI + ZMQ 控制通道。** 无需浏览器，通过单个 `.py` 配置文件驱动完整的部署/评估/RL/收集循环——每个控制台按钮（包括 HIL 接管）都镜像到 ZMQ 套接字上。参见 [`docs/console.md`](./docs/console.md) 和 [`docs/control-channel.md`](./docs/control-channel.md)。 * **[2026-07-03] EVA-Client 开源！** * **[2026-07-03] 论文、文档和项目页面已上线！** 阅读 [技术报告]
